[[File:Nav_buoy.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A navigation buoy]]
{{Quote|Incoming ships! They are entering the area near buoy B-18.|[[Outpost D-34]] to [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]|<ref name="TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''Navigation buoys''', also known as '''marker buoys''' or '''beacon-buoys'''<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> were navigational aids deployed in [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] to mark [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] into and out of a [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="TIE Fighter" /> and to denote [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jumpzones]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] reverting to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] calculated their jump to arrive near a navigation buoy to ensure their passage was free of danger.<ref name="PP" />

Buoys were typically assigned an alphanumeric callsign, such as "B-145."<ref name="TIE Fighter" /> They could also be employed by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to mark a newly discovered territory as "claimed" while they headed back to civilized space to register their find.<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>
